jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and – in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders – seek to shape policy so that it aligns with and supports our mission. About the Role As AI agents move from answering questions to taking action across the internet, the standards that govern identity, delegated authority, discovery, communications, agentic-commerce and payment interfaces, agent-facing web access, agent-specific provenance, and auditability will determine whether agents can operate safely, interoperably, and with clear accountability. OpenAI is looking for an Agent Standards Architect to lead execution of our external technical standards strategy for a defined set of agent standards workstreams. This role will work closely with Agent Security, Applied and Platform teams, Product, Legal, GRC, Global Affairs, and GTM to turn OpenAI’s technical architecture and controls into credible specifications, protocol profiles, assurance criteria, and implementation guidance—and to bring emerging external requirements back into product and security roadmaps before they become blockers. The positions developed here are technical standards positions, not broad public-policy positions. This is a builder’s role as much as an external-facing role. You will execute a prioritized standards plan, author and negotiate protocols, build coalitions, secure the right internal approvals, and represent OpenAI in assigned technical forums. You will also help create repeatable processes that let the company shape agent standards without depending on a single person or relying on technical teams to carry external standards work on top of their core jobs. The Agent Standards Architect is an integrator, not the owner of every underlying technical system. Security, Product, Engineering, and other designated technical teams retain ownership of architecture, threat models, controls, product decisions, approvals, and implementation. This role owns workstream planning, standards translation, drafting, negotiation, external representation within approved mandates, commitment traceability, and implementation handoff. In this role, you will: - Own a focused workstream plan for core agent identity, discovery, and delegated-authorization standards, with adjacent agentic-commerce, web-access, provenance, and auditability work assigned through portfolio prioritization. - Recommend where OpenAI should lead, shape, monitor, oppose, or decline to participate within the assigned workstream, based on technical maturity, governance quality, strategic leverage, implementation readiness, and company priorities. - Develop technical standards positions and normative contributions that preserve distinctions among the human or service principal, agent, workload or runtime, task, session, resource, and policy decision. - Shape requirements for scoped delegation, attenuation, step-up approval, revocation, credential custody, runtime binding, discovery, interoperability, agent-specific provenance, and auditable action trails. - Embed with Agent Security and Applied or Platform teams to translate internal architecture and controls into technically credible specifications, profiles, white papers, and assurance evidence without overstating maturity or deployment status. - Lead review and approval paths across Product, Security, Engineering, Legal, GRC, Global Affairs, and GTM; maintain clear mandates, red lines, owners, dependencies, and external commitments. - Represent OpenAI in priority venues and coalitions, such as IETF and OAuth-related work, FIDO, OIDF, W3C, AAIF, and relevant NIST or ISO efforts; build trust with peer companies, standards operators, and public-sector stakeholders. - Bring external standards intelligence back into product, security, compliance, and go-to-market decisions early enough to shape roadmaps and avoid retrofit, launch, procurement, or market-access friction. - Contribute reusable playbooks, decision records, contribution patterns, and handoffs that reduce key-person risk across the assigned workstream. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have strong experience in technical standards, internet protocols, identity and access, security architecture, applied cryptography, or closely related product or infrastructure work. - Have authored, edited, or materially shaped normative specifications, profiles, drafts, or conformance requirements in serious technical standards or open-source governance settings. - Can reason clearly about OAuth and OIDC, FIDO or WebAuth, workload identity, HTTP signatures, delegated authority, credential lifecycle, revocation, provenance, and auditability; you do not need to be expert in every layer. - Understand that agent trust is a composed stack rather than a single credential, and can separate principal, agent, runtime, task, session, resource, and policy claims. - Can distinguish adopted standards, stable extensions, active drafts, working-group proposals, and exploratory ideas—and know how that maturity should change OpenAI’s posture. - Earn trust with engineers and security leaders while also communicating crisply with lawyers, product leaders, executives, policymakers, and external standards participants. - Have strong judgment in ambiguous, high-stakes environments and know when to lead, compromise, oppose, escalate, or walk away. - Write clearly, negotiate constructively, and are comfortable representing OpenAI externally with discretion. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Enterprise is central to Anthropic's mission. The organizations that could benefit most from Claude often have the most demanding needs, with rigorous requirements around end-user experience, procurement, security, and permissions. We believe earning their trust is essential to ensuring AI benefits the world broadly.
We're looking for a Staff+ Engineer to anchor our Enterprise pillar—the team that makes Claude enterprise-ready at scale. When a Fortune 500 company wants to roll out Claude to 100,000 employees, the systems and products that you design are what make it possible.
This is a high-agency role that spans multiple efforts within Enterprise. Have 10+ years of engineering experience with a clear track record operating at Staff or Senior Staff level.

Fintech Privacy Team은 쿠팡페이의 개인(신용)정보 보호 체계를 구축 및 운영하며 관련 법규 준수와 개인(신용)정보 리스크 관리를 담당합니다. 팀은 개인(신용)정보 Life Cycle 관리, 개인정보 내부통제 운영, 정보보호 인증 대응, 개인(신용)정보보호 솔루션 운영을 통해 고객 정보의 안전성을 확보하고 있습니다. 또한 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하여 개인(신용)정보 보호 프로세스를 개선하고 법규 준수 체계를 유지하는 역할을 수행합니다.
업무 내용
개인(신용)정보처리시스템의 사용자별 접근 권한 체계를 운영하며, 최소권한 원칙에 따른 권한 부여·변경·회수 요청 검토 및 주기적인 접근 권한 점검·모니터링을 수행
RFI(Request for Information, 개인신용정보 추출 및 제공) 프로세스를 운영하며, 개인(신용)정보 추출 요청의 적정성을 검토하고 데이터 제공 이력을 관리하여 정보 유출 위험을 최소화
개인(신용)정보처리시스템의 화면, 접근 현황 및 개인(신용)정보 처리 실태를 점검하고 관련 리스크를 식별하여 개선 활동을 수행
개인정보보호법, 신용정보법 및 내부 정책에 따른 준수 현황을 점검하고 내부통제 모니터링을 수행하여 개인(신용)정보 보호 수준을 강화
전사 개인(신용)정보보호 체계 강화를 위한 Ad-hoc 과제를 지원하고, 개인정보 접근통제 및 보호체계 운영체계를 지속적으로 개선하기 위해 다양한 이해관계자와 협업

jobs.description: Overview Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. Come join a #1 team and do some good! Responsibilities Are you ready to drive impressive growth in a dynamic market? As our next Sales Leader, your primary purpose is to be the engine of territory growth. You will achieve this by leveraging comprehensive market knowledge and utilizing effective agent sales consulting to dramatically enhance the customer experience and meet diverse needs. This role is crucial for fostering a culture of high engagement and adaptability within the sales territory, helping to position our independent contractor agents to capture every bit of market potential. If you are passionate about leadership, growth, and building winning teams, we want to hear from you! In this job you are primarily responsible for: Driving Territory Results : Using in-depth market knowledge and effective sales strategies to meet customer needs and deliver exceptional experiences Business Coaching: Coaching agents on aspects of business management to evolve with customer demands and meet their business objectives Agent Placement and Development: Overseeing the process of strategically placing and developing agents to maximize market opportunities Location: New Jersey Summit Sales Territory The Summit Sales Territory is based in Northern New Jersey and includes 54 Agents across Union, Essex, and Middlesex Counties, plus a smaller footprint in Bergen and Hudson Counties. The territory spans dense urban centers and affluent suburban commuter communities tied closely to the New York City economy. This creates a dynamic and varied market with strong potential across customer segments. The Agent force includes a healthy mix of new and tenured Agents and a range of performance levels—creating a great runway for a leader who can build momentum, coach to higher capability, and drive results. Qualifications Preferred Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in insurance, financial services or sales leadership, showcasing strong expertise and a genuine passion for the insurance and financial services industry. Strong track record of coaching and influencing sales professionals and implementing organizational and territory strategies that drive growth and customer service. Expertise in identifying and pursuing innovative approaches to enhance insurance and financial services outcomes. Ability to recruit and select entrepreneurs looking to own their own business while contributing to the success of our organization. Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with sales professionals, senior field leaders, and key business partners to leverage knowledge and expertise to enhance your ability to drive results. Ability to coach and consult with sales professionals in hosting needs-based conversations covering a spectrum of customer needs. Demonstrated entrepreneurial mindset with proven track record of successfully launching, managing, or growing a business or startup utilizing innovation, strategic planning, and critical thinking skills. Excellent communication, relationship-building, interpersonal, and coaching skills. Presentation skills - effectively conveys information in a clear and professional manner to internal and/or external individuals/groups. Ability to effectively communicate and negotiate with others to reach mutually beneficial solutions with both internal and external individual/groups. Additional Details Selected candidates will be required to possess and/or obtain a Securities Industries Essentials (SIE), Series 6 license, and Series 63, Series 65 or equivalent, Life/Health, Variable license and Property and Casualty License. Fingerprint, credit check and background check are required for sponsorship of FINRA licensing. Employees must successfully obtain all other applicable licensing and certifications for role including, but not limited to, LTC Certification, Annuities Certification and potential state securities licensing, as applicable. Employees may be required to sign the Acknowledgement of Policy on Personal Account Transactions Must work flexible, non-standard hours, including weekends and holidays, based on operational needs and workload Selected employees must maintain a valid license to lawfully operate vehicles as requested by the company. MVR check will be completed as part of the pre-employment process. Requirements subject to change at State Farm discretion based on a business need. Competitive candidates will need to successfully complete the Sales Leader Approval process. **Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H-1B Visa) or future need for this opportunity** ***Last date to apply: 7/31/2026 at 11:00pm, CST*** The State Farm Sales Practices Philosophy is about placing customer needs first, operating fairly and doing the right thing. We strive to encourage customer conversations, customer service, and meeting customer needs in our related promotions, rewards, and incentives. State Farm agents are independent contractors. As independent contractors, State Farm agents hire their own employees, make all decisions regarding their employees and are responsible for their own business operations. State Farm does not manage, exercise or assume control of independent contractor agents’ business operations or employees. Our Benefits The fixed annual salary for this role is $200,000 and employees are not eligible for annual merit increases. Employees may be eligible for a geographic differential based on the location from which an employee is working. Employees may be eligible to participate in incentive programs, including a quarterly bonus and an annual bonus. The total compensation opportunity, including a fixed base salary and potential incentive pay eligibility for this position is $200,000 - $310,000 with the possibility for incentive earnings to exceed this range. No amount of incentive compensation is guaranteed. Remote Work Arrangement: The Sales Leader role is a remote position which requires the selected candidate to work out of his/her home and will require periodic travel to conduct/attend meetings and/or seminars, training, conferences. Securities Licensing This position requires you to obtain/maintain all applicable FINRA licensing exams (Securities Industry Essentials, Series 6, Series 63, and Series 65 or equivalent), sponsorship from State Farm VP Management Corp (SFVPMC) and State Farm Investment Management Corp. (SFIMC), and that you become registered and remain in good standing as required by SFVPMC, SFIMC and FINRA. To confirm eligibility for sponsorship, you will complete fingerprinting and a credit check. This is in addition to the pre-employment background check. You will be required to sign a Securities Registration Agreement upon hire. At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family! Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits , locations , and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team!

jobs.description: ARMO Mechanic II ¿Te apasiona el mantenimiento de equipos mecánicos y el soporte a operaciones críticas de Oil & Gas? ¿Disfrutas trabajar directamente con equipos de completación mientras contribuyes a una prestación de servicios segura y eficiente? ¡Únete a nuestro equipo! Acerca de nosotros En Baker Hughes estamos transformando el futuro de la energía. Con operaciones en más de 120 países, desarrollamos e implementamos tecnologías y servicios líderes en la industria para impulsar el avance energético. Durante más de un siglo, nuestras innovaciones han revolucionado el sector energético. Hoy, ponemos nuestra experiencia al servicio de una energía más segura, más limpia y más eficiente. Forma equipo con los mejores Como ARMO Mechanic II, brindarás soporte en el ensamblaje, desensamblaje, mantenimiento e inspección de equipos de completación utilizados en operaciones petroleras. En este puesto, seguirás procedimientos de mantenimiento y estándares operativos establecidos para garantizar la confiabilidad, calidad y seguridad de los equipos. Trabajarás de cerca con equipos de campo y taller mientras continúas desarrollando tu experiencia técnica en sistemas de completación y tecnologías relacionadas de Oil & Gas. Como ARMO Mechanic II, serás responsable de lo siguiente: · Realizar el ensamblaje y desensamblaje de equipos petroleros y de completación de acuerdo con los procedimientos establecidos. · Seguir prácticas formales de mantenimiento y estándares operativos para aplicaciones estandarizadas. · Inspeccionar, mantener y preparar equipos para garantizar su disponibilidad operativa y confiabilidad. · Apoyar actividades de mantenimiento y reparación cumpliendo con los requisitos de calidad y seguridad. · Desarrollar conocimientos técnicos sobre equipos de completación y sistemas relacionados. · Aprender y utilizar nuevas herramientas, tecnologías y sistemas operativos asociados a los productos y servicios de Baker Hughes. · Mantener registros precisos de mantenimiento y documentación de equipos. · Colaborar estrechamente con personal de taller, equipos de campo y especialistas técnicos. · Cumplir con todas las políticas, procedimientos y estándares operativos de HSE de Baker Hughes. · Contribuir a iniciativas de mejora continua dentro de la organización de mantenimiento y reparación. Alimenta tu pasión Para tener éxito en este puesto, es necesario: · Contar con título universitario en Ingeniería Mecánica o Ingeniería de Petróleo. · Tener un mínimo de 1 año de experiencia industrial relevante en la industria de Oil & Gas. · Demostrar conocimientos de equipos de completación y operaciones petroleras. · Poseer habilidades básicas de computación. · Tener disposición para aprender continuamente nuevos sistemas, herramientas y tecnologías. · Demostrar un sólido compromiso con la calidad, la seguridad y la excelencia operativa. · Tener capacidad para trabajar de manera efectiva en entornos orientados al trabajo en equipo. Características deseadas · Fuerte aptitud mecánica y habilidades para diagnóstico y resolución de fallas. · Conocimiento de herramientas y equipos de completación utilizados en la industria petrolera. · Enfoque práctico y orientado a la ejecución de actividades de mantenimiento y reparación. · Alto nivel de atención al detalle y compromiso con la calidad. · Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo. · Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a nuevas tecnologías y procesos de trabajo. · Orientación al cliente y compromiso con la excelencia operativa. · Capacidad para trabajar de manera segura y eficiente en un entorno operativo dinámico. Trabaje de la manera que más le convenga Reconocemos que cada persona es diferente y que la forma en que las personas quieren trabajar y dar lo mejor de sí también es diferente para cada persona. Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
About the Role
The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. Creators are the engine of Roblox. When something breaks for them, whether it is a broken publish flow, a payout that didn't land, an asset that won't upload, how quickly and how well we resolve it directly shapes whether they keep building with us.
You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Senior Product Support Specialist on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll own the hardest escalations end to end, drive root cause analysis with engineering and product partners, and then close the loop by turning what you learn into support content that scales for both our human agents and our automated support experiences.
Additionally, you will serve as a product expert working closely with the Product Support Management team, providing detailed synthesis of new and existing issues our users experience to prioritize and enable engineering teams to improve the platform. You'll operate with a high degree of independence.
You Will
Support health and proactive gap identification
Co-monitor the health of creator support: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where creators are getting stuck.
Mine ticket, content, and automation data for patterns: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, product gaps and surface them proactively with a recommendation attached to the PSM.
Independently own root cause analysis for complex, high-impact, and ambiguous creator issues including ones that cross product, platform, and policy boundaries..
Get ahead of launches: review upcoming product and policy changes, pressure test them from a support perspective, and make sure content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before creators feel the change. Support PSM in preparing RCA or post launch report to surface to all concerned stakeholder (engineering, product, operations etc)
Report clearly and regularly to support and product leadership on where creator support is strong, where it's degrading, and what you propose to do about it.
Drive operational excellence in how creator support runs: hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling, and treat every process change as something to be measured rather than assumed. Where the current way of working is the bottleneck, you name it and fix it.
Product Feedback Loop:
Partner directly with Product Managers (PMs) during alpha/beta testing phases to provide a "Supportability Scorecard" for major upcoming platform features.
Knowledge & Support Content
Author and maintain the authoritative internal knowledge base agents rely on which includes but is not restricted to troubleshooting guides, decision trees, macros, policy interpretations and keep it accurate as the product changes underneath it.
Own creator support content, which includes (but is not limited to) intent-ready articles, structured resolution paths, and clear, unambiguous source material for support agents to rely on.
Build automation and self-service experiences, supplying the content and acting as a subject-matter judgment behind them, and flagging where automation is producing wrong or incomplete answers.
Serve as a senior point of contact during high-severity creator-facing incidents, coordinating across support, engineering, and comms, when needed
Raise the bar on escalation quality across the team by setting the standard for what a well-formed escalation looks like, and reduce the volume that shouldn't have escalated in the first place
You Have
7+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues.
Excellent written communication. You have the ability to explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer and to a frustrated creator.
Comfort with ambiguity and genuine self-direction. You choose your own problems, defend your prioritization, and close things out without being managed.
Strong cross-functional influence without authority, you can get engineering and product to care about a support problem.
Nice to Have
Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that your content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
Experience writing or structuring content balancing automation driven human in the loop support, self-service, etc.
Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience rather than a general consumer base.
Working knowledge of Roblox as a creation platform; Studio, Lua, the developer economy or comparable experience with a UGC platform.
Data & Diagnostic Proficiency:
Comfortable querying datasets (SQL, Tableau, or similar BI tools) and analyzing diagnostic logs to isolate bugs before routing to engineering.

jobs.description: At IO Interactive , we believe great games are built by great teams, and great teams thrive in great environments. Someone who notices the details others miss, takes ownership naturally, and enjoys creating a workplace where people feel welcome, supported, and excited to be. From celebrating team milestones and organising studio events to solving last-minute challenges and keeping our spaces looking their best, you'll be at the centre of what makes IOI a great place to work. Take ownership of the spaces around you, ensuring kitchens, lounges, meeting rooms, gaming areas, and communal spaces are clean, organised, and inviting. Proactively spot issues before they become problems and take action to resolve them. Ensure fridges are stocked, coffee is flowing, supplies are available, and the studio feels cared for. Support meeting preparations and help keep shared spaces looking their best throughout the day. Be hands-on when needed. If something has spilled, needs tidying, fixing, moving, or organising, you jump in and make it happen. Coordinate practical studio activities and support colleagues with day-to-day requests. Handle a wide variety of ad hoc tasks, large and small, that help keep the studio running smoothly. Events & Culture Support the planning and execution of social events, celebrations, team activities, and studio gatherings. Build and maintain relationships with local vendors, suppliers, venues, and partners, so you always know who to call when something is needed quickly. Be part of creating the moments that make IOI feel special, from milestone celebrations to spontaneous team activities. (Occasional evening support may be needed after events.) Who You Are You're the kind of person who sees something that needs doing and simply gets it done. You don't believe in "that's not my job". If something needs doing and it helps the studio, the people, or the culture, you step in and make it happen. One minute you're welcoming a guest; the next you're arranging catering for a team that just hit a major milestone, finding a DJ for tomorrow's studio event, cleaning up a coffee spill before anyone notices, or helping solve a problem nobody knew was theirs to own. You are resourceful, connected, and proactive. When someone says, "We need this by tomorrow," your instinct is not to explain why it's difficult. It's to say: "I've got this. jobs.description: The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration. The AWS Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at AWS, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch, enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. You will architect and implement business-critical features, publish cutting-edge research, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. jobs.description: The opportunity We are building the next generation of AI-driven game experiences — generative world models, neural rendering, and multi-modal understanding that turn images, text, and 3D primitives into interactive worlds.
